subject: Dedicated deployment residency & on-demand deletion: confirmation and evidence
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finserv.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finserv.com
Date: 2027-10-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Dedicated deployment — residency & deletion questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before our procurement team signs off on Dedicated, Security has asked for firm confirmations around three items:

1) Region anchoring: if we pin a tenant to us-west-2, can you guarantee all persistent storage (model artifacts, logs, and any tenant-scoped object store) will remain in that region and not replicate to other regions?
2) Deletion / proof: when we request a tenant wipe, what evidence can you provide that data has been erased (timestamps, operation ids, and sanitized logs)? Is there an on-demand attestation?
3) Isolation & backups: do backups ever cross-region for DR? If so, what legal/contractual controls apply and can we opt out?

We need short, concrete answers and an example runbook for an on-demand wipe for our auditors. Goal is to ensure the decision can be finalized this month.

Best,
Carlos
Director, Platform Security
FinServ Bank
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finserv.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-18T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment — residency & deletion questions

Carlos — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, more detail below and attached a concise checklist + playbook.

1) Region anchoring: Yes — for Dedicated we support region pinning at the tenant level. Persistent storage for tenant-scoped data (S3 buckets, block storage snapshots, and model artifacts we host) is provisioned in the pinned region and is not replicated to other regions by default.

2) Deletion / proof: We provide a time-stamped operation id for every wipe request, a signed attestation PDF, and a shrink-wrapped evidence bundle (log excerpt + internal job id + cleanup ledger). The attached "tenant-wipe-playbook.docx" shows the fields we provide.

3) Isolation & backups: Backups are configurable. By default, Dedicated backups remain in-region. Customers can opt into cross-region DR; doing so is explicit in the onboarding contract and requires approvals and controls (encryption keys bound to your KMS, separate access logs).

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-residency-checklist.pdf; tenant-wipe-playbook.docx

I'll loop in Karthik on the low-level mechanics (replication controls, replication TTLs, and snapshot retention) and Marissa on operations evidence and SLA flow. Happy to set a quick call to walk the auditors through the playbook.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finserv.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T08:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment — residency & deletion questions

Carlos — technical addendum below. Keeping to the three bullets from your note: 

1) Region anchoring (detail): Tenant-scoped object stores are created as region-specific buckets (we use customer-tagged buckets in the pinned region). Model runtime KV caches and ephemeral paging may cross AZs but not cross regions. We do not proactively replicate tenant persistent artifacts to other regions unless cross-region DR is explicitly enabled.

2) Deletion / proof (detail): Wipe flow is an orchestrated job: (a) mark tenant record 'scheduled_for_wipe' with an opaque operation id, (b) execute sequential delete tasks across storage types, (c) run verification sweeps and generate a ledger entry per resource type with SHA-256 digests removed (we only keep resource ids and timestamps), (d) return a signed attestation with operation id, timestamp, and list of cleaned resource ids. The attestation is generated via our KMS-backed signing service; example PDF attached (residency-attestation-draft.pdf).

3) Isolation & backups (detail): Snapshots/backups default to in-region S3 prefix. If cross-region DR is enabled, backups are copied to a customer-designated region using AES-256 encryption and a dedicated KMS key (customer-managed if required). When customers opt out of cross-region DR, we enforce policy at provisioning and prevent the copy job from being scheduled.

Also attached: region-routing-diagram.png (shows network/data paths for Dedicated in us-west-2).

If you want, we can run a test wipe in a staging tenant and produce the evidence bundle and signed attestation within 48 hours. That would be the fastest way to satisfy an auditor.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finserv.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T15:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment — residency & deletion questions

Carlos, Priya — operational notes from the runbook perspective: 

- Standard SLA for tenant wipe request (kickoff -> final attestation) is 72 hours for Dedicated customers with enterprise SLA. We can compress to 48 hours for FinServ Bank as a one-off commitment; will flag in the contract addendum.
- Evidence bundle contents: operation_id, timestamps per resource, job logs (redacted for internal-only fields), signed attestation PDF, and a signed digest of the ledger. We host the bundle in a customer-only S3 location and provide pre-signed, time-limited download.
- Audit support: we can do a remote walk-through with your auditors and provide redactable logs. For hard compliance (e.g., regulators on-site), we support a field runbook and on-prem witness.

Next steps I propose:
1) We schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough (we can show a staging wipe).
2) You confirm whether you want cross-region DR opt-in for backups.
3) We prepare the contract addendum text for the 48-hour wipe SLA and the attestation language.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@finserv.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-20T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Dedicated deployment — residency & deletion questions

Team — thanks, this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A couple of quick follow-ups before I route to procurement: 

1) Please confirm the exact retention TTLs you enforce for workspace logs and model artifact snapshots by default (we need numbers for the contract).
2) For the on-demand wipe evidence: will the signed attestation include the SHA-256 prefixes for each cleaned object (we only need prefixes to correlate to our records, not full hashes)?
3) Please send the contract addendum language for the 48-hour SLA and the opt-out clause for cross-region backup copies.

If you can provide answers and the addendum draft by EOD Friday, we can keep our procurement timeline. Also, yes — a staging wipe and evidence bundle would expedite auditors.

Best,
Carlos
